h: Obasanjo's son names his preferred 2027 presidential candidate
p: A son of former President Olusegun Obasanjo has reportedly named the candidate he would like to see win the 2027 presidential election. His comments have added to the debate about the opposition and ruling-party tickets. The family name carries weight in Nigerian politics, so the remarks are being widely discussed.
more: He spoke about what he wants to see from the next president.
